انطرقت (form VII)

# اِنْطَرَقْتَ (inṭaraqta) /in.tˤa.raq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# اِنْطَرَقْتِ (inṭaraqti) /in.tˤa.raq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْطَرَقَ (inṭaraqa)
# اِنْطَرَقَتْ (inṭaraqat) /in.tˤa.ra.qat/: third-pe
